name: tapthat
description: DON'T TAP THAT — a reflex/psychological tap game for iPhone (web core + Capacitor native wrapper).

scripts.assets: npm run icons && npm run splash && cp icons/icon-1024.png assets/icon.png && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios
scripts.ios:add: npm run www && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run www && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
